$comment: ARC-005: frontmatter serialization vectors shared by Python (tests/test_frontmatter_parity.py, via core.vault_index.serialize_frontmatter/parse_frontmatter) and TypeScript (visualizer/lib/frontmatter.parity.test.ts, via lib/frontmatter.ts). fields is the shared model: related holds BARE stems (the Python emitter wraps them as [[wikilinks]]; the TS editor stores stems and quotes them on serialize); project/provenance/session_id are '' when absent (project is omitted, provenance/session_id ride the TS extra round-trip and the Python canonical key order — both emit them after related). expected is the full --- block including the trailing newline. Both suites assert serialize(model) == expected and parse(expected) == model. Vector values stay within the shared YAML subset (no item containing both quote characters, no trailing empty items).
